question: What exact condition labels and tag identifiers occur in the four deposited reference CSVs and feature tables after whitespace normalization?
decision: Correct the two documented source_v1 metadata interpretations; retain unknown cell assignments and animal/pool identities without qualifying biological analyses.
strongest_rival: Whitespace-sensitive parsing and a global join on reused tag identifiers can create false labels or imply unverified sample identities.
discriminator: Trim CSV headers and values; enumerate each feature table separately; check reference-file/tag-ID membership across every table without interpreting overlap as condition support or biological pairing.
exposure_record: Exposed before this freeze: source_v1 output, coordinating review corrections, and the four reference CSV labels and tag lists. Prior reviewers inspected feature-table CMO rows. This session read the source labels before freezing; the later freeze does not erase this exposure. No biological outcome comparison is planned or executed.
biological_unit: Source reference record or deposited feature table; animal and independently collected pool identities remain unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Reused tag names are record-local identifiers. All reference-file/tag-ID by feature-file membership checks are descriptive string matches, not cell assignments, biological pairing or independent replication.
population_and_selection: Exactly four reference CSVs, their four compressed originals, four feature tables and eight associated accession records from the hash-verified local public-source cache; no matrices, barcodes, counts or outcome-based selection.
contrast: Reference label and feature-identifier census, with a separate computational comparison to compressed references; no biological contrast.
endpoint: Whitespace-normalized source labels, source accession/title fields, feature types and per-table tag-ID membership.
methods: Standard-library CSV and gzip readers; trim header/value boundaries while retaining label spelling and internal punctuation; reject missing required headers/values, duplicate normalized headers and duplicate tag IDs. Independently verify labels using a positional reader on compressed source references and verify all feature inventories and membership rows using a separate line/set calculation.
missingness_and_exclusions: Malformed or missing required metadata fields fail the run rather than creating blank labels. No reference row or table is selectively excluded. Animal/pool identity, assigned cells and actual condition-by-library support remain unknown.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or multiple-testing claims.
precision_basis: Metadata census of available files; no population uncertainty or power claim.
interpretation_limit: Reference labels and feature presence do not establish cell conditions, animal/pool identity, independence, condition/library confounding, absence of confounding or any biological effect. Stage 0 remains partial; stages 1-8 remain unexecuted.
stop_rule: Stop on input hash mismatch, missing/malformed metadata or independent verification mismatch; preserve failure records. Do not inspect count matrices, assign cells, infer animals, estimate expression differences, scan motifs or derive mechanisms.
amendment_reason: New metadata-only version corrects the documented trailing-space header artifact and replaces unsupported categorical condition/library confounding with an unresolved statement. Preserves all source_v1 code, contract, outputs and receipt; does not rerun other v1 measurements or broaden biological scope.
